mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT F.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT F LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION R ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID WHERE F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' AND F.MDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.AMOUNT > 0

SELECT DISTINCT F.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT F LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE R ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID WHERE F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' AND F.MDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.AMOUNT > 0 AND R.DATE_TYPE = 0

SELECT R.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, R.FINPROD_ID finprodId, sum(R.AMOUNT) repNomCapi, R.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, F.MDATE mdate, F.VDATE vdate, F.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, sci.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE R LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = R.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on R.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' AND R.DATE_TYPE = 0 AND R.AMOUNT > 0 group by R.PORTFOLIO_ID, R.FINPROD_ID, R.SEC_ACCT_ID, F.MDATE, F.VDATE, F.TRADE_MARKET, sci.ACCT_NO

SELECT R.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, R.FINPROD_ID finprodId, sum(R.AMOUNT) repNomCapi, R.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, F.MDATE mdate, F.VDATE vdate, F.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, sci.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION R LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON R.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = R.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on R.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND R.CDATE = #{executeDate} AND R.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND R.AMOUNT > 0 group by R.PORTFOLIO_ID, R.FINPROD_ID, R.SEC_ACCT_ID, F.MDATE, F.VDATE, F.TRADE_MARKET, sci.ACCT_NO

SELECT T.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T.SHARE_AMT repNomCapi, T.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId, T.VDATE vdate, T.MDATE mdate, T.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T.TRADE_ID tradeId FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD A ON A.TRADE_ID = T.TRADE_ID WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}

select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.VDATE vDate, fp.MDATE mDate, fpd.REF_ENTITY refEntity, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME refEntityStr, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE creditEvent, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE paBussType, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_HAPPENED_DATE creditEventHappenedDate, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_RESOLVE_DATE creditEventResolveDate, tfpdl.M_DELIVERY_TYPE settleMethod, TDTA.DELIVER_BOND deliverBond, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE deliverDate, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, fp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fpd.REF_ENTITY where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.VDATE vDate, fp.MDATE mDate, fpd.REF_ENTITY refEntity, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME refEntityStr, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE creditEvent, tfpdl.TG_BUSI_TYPE paBussType, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_HAPPENED_DATE creditEventHappenedDate, TDTA.CREDIT_EVENT_RESOLVE_DATE creditEventResolveDate, tfpdl.M_DELIVERY_TYPE settleMethod, TDTA.DELIVER_BOND deliverBond, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE deliverDate, tfpdl.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, fp.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdl left join WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fpd.REF_ENTITY where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(tfpdl.SHARE_AMT, 0) repNomCapi, nvl(T.SHARE_AMT, 0) deliverBondAmount, DECODE(TG.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, '02', nvl(tfpdl.TRADE_AMT, 0), NVL(T.TRADE_AMT, 0)) deliveryAmount, tfpdl.REMARK remark from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tfpdl left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TG ON TG.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01') T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TFPDL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = T.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' union all select tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sci.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo, tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(tfpdl.SHARE_AMT, 0) repNomCapi, nvl(T.SHARE_AMT, 0) deliverBondAmount, DECODE(TG.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, '02', nvl(tfpdl.TRADE_AMT, 0), NVL(T.TRADE_AMT, 0)) deliveryAmount, tfpdl.REMARK remark from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tfpdl left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TG ON TG.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01') T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TFPDL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = T.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd on fpd.FINPROD_ID = tfpdl.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = tfpdl.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID = sci.ACCT_NO where tfpdl.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and tfpdl.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37'
